blocks.title: Dimensions
blocks.text: Koi bhi physical quantity length, mass, time, temperature aur electric current jaisi maanoos khusoosiyat se bayan ki ja sakti hai; yeh napi jane wali khusoosiyat dimensions kehlati hain. Dimensions bunyadi quantities ke zariye physical quantity ki maahiyat (qualitative nature) se nimatti hain. Length, depth, height, diameter aur light year jaisi quantities sab metre mein napi jati hain aur ek hi dimension, length, se zahir hoti hain, jise square brackets mein L likha jata hai, [L]. Isi tarah mass, time, electric current aur temperature [M], [T], [A] aur [theta] se zahir hote hain. Yeh paanch dimensions bunyadi chuni gayi hain kyunke tajurbon mein inhen napna aasan hai.

Doosri quantities ki dimensions batati hain ke woh bunyadi quantities se kaise juri hain aur bunyadi dimensions ke milap hain. Speed v metre per second mein napi jati hai, to us ki dimensions length taqseem time hain: [v] = [L]/[T] = [L][T^-1] = [LT^-1]. Chunke acceleration a = delta v / delta t, [a] = [v]/[T] = [LT^-1]/[T] = [LT^-2]. Isi tarah force ki dimensions [F] = [m][a] = [M][LT^-2] = [MLT^-2] likhi ja sakti hain. Dimensionality ke istemal se hum physical equation ki homogeneity (durustagi) jaanch sakte hain, aur kisi physical quantity ka formula bhi akhz kar sakte hain.

Equation ki durustagi yeh dikha kar jaanchi ja sakti hai ke equation ke dono taraf quantities ki dimensions ek jaisi hain; yeh homogeneity ka usool hai. Farz karein ek car sukoon se (v_i = 0) chalti hai aur acceleration a se chalte hue waqt t mein faasla S tay karti hai. Equation of motion S = v_i t + (1/2) a t^2, ya S = (1/2) a t^2 hai. 1/2 jaise adadi factors ki koi dimensions nahi, to unhen nazar andaz kiya ja sakta hai. Dono taraf ki dimensions rakhte hue: [S] = [a][t^2]; dimensions ke symbols likhte hue, [L] = [LT^-2][T^2] = [LT^-2 T^2], ya [L] = [L]. Dono taraf ki dimensions ek jaisi hain, is liye equation dimensionally durust hai.
Dimensionality un mukhtalif factors ke durust andaze se, jin par quantity munhasir hai, kisi physical quantity ka mumkina formula akhz karne ko istemal ho sakti hai.

blocks.title: Example 1.4
blocks.text: Kisi cheez ko yaksan raftar se daire par chalaye rakhne ke liye darkar centripetal force ka formula akhz karein, yeh farz karte hue ke centripetal force cheez ke mass, daire ke radius aur yaksan speed par munhasir hai. Hal: chunke force mass m, radius r aur yaksan speed v par munhasir hai, F m^a v^b r^c ke mutanasib hai, to F = (constant) m^a v^b r^c ... (i), jahan exponents a, b aur c tay karne hain. Homogeneity ke usool se dono taraf ki dimensions ek jaisi honi chahiye; constant ki koi dimension nahi, to use nazar andaz karte hue: [F] = [m^a][v^b][r^c], [MLT^-2] = [M^a][L/T]^b[L]^c = [M^a][LT^-1]^b[L]^c, [MLT^-2] = [M^a L^(b+c) T^-b] ... (ii). Dono taraf dimensions ki powers ka muqabla karte hue: a = 1; b + c = 1; -b = -2. Hal karne par a = 1, b = 2, c = -1. Yeh qeematein equation (i) mein rakhte hue: F = (constant) m v^2 r^-1, ya F = (constant) m v^2 / r. Constant ki adadi qeemat dimensional analysis se tay nahi ho sakti; yeh tajurbe se milti hai, aur yahan 1 hai, to equation F = m v^2 / r ban jati hai.

Dimensional tareeqa yeh nahi bata sakta ke equation kahan ghalat hai. Agar equation durust sabit ho bhi jaye to hum sirf keh sakte hain ke equation durust ho sakti hai, kyunke yeh tareeqa kisi adadi factor ya constant ki jaanch nahi deta; woh sirf tajurbon se ya variables ke darmiyan munasib graph bana kar tay ho sakta hai.

blocks.text: Side boxes: Colorado (USA) ke National Institute of Standards and Technology ka caesium atomic frequency standard waqt ke unit ka bunyadi standard hai; escapement, pallets wala anchor jo escape wheel se jura hai aur pendulum se regulate hota hai, woh device hai jis ne pendulum clock ko amali banaya; khaas darja hararat ka scale Suraj ke bahri hisse (taqreeban 6000 degrees C) se lamp ke filament, garajte Bunsen shole, pighalte aluminium aur ubalte mercury se hota hua ubalte pani (100 degrees C), pighalti barf (0 degrees C), jamte alcohol, liquid banti hawa aur absolute zero (-273 degrees C) tak jata hai; aur calculators utne hindse dete hain jitni un ki memory ijazat de, to aakhri jawab significant figures ki durust tadaad tak round karne chahiye (Beware).

blocks.alt: Thermometer jaisa scale, degrees Celsius mein, upar 7000 se neeche -273 tak; scale yaksan (uniform) nahi. Nishan: Suraj ka bahri hissa, filament lamp, tez Bunsen shola, aluminium pighalta hai, mercury ubalta hai, pani ubalta hai (100 C), alcohol ubalta hai, insani jism, barf pighalti hai (0 C), mercury jamta hai, sab se thanda mausam, alcohol jamta hai, hawa liquid banti hai aur absolute zero.
blocks.caption: Kuch khaas darja-e-hararat (Interesting Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is scale ke faasle barabar nahi: 0 se 100 C ka hissa khula hai aur 1000 C se oopar har 1000 C ka hissa chhota hai, taake -273 C se Suraj ke taqreeban 5500 C tak sab ek hi pattee par aa jaye. Is liye nishanon ke darmiyan faasle se hisab na lagayein, sirf likhi qeematein parhein: pani 100 C par ubalta hai, insani jism taqreeban 37 C, mercury -39 C par jamta hai aur absolute zero -273 C hai.

blocks.alt: Pendulum oopar ek pivot se latakta hai. Us ke saath juda khamdar anchor hai jis ke do pallet daanton wale escape wheel ke daanton ko pakarte hain; teer dikhata hai ke wheel clockwise ghoomta hai. Labels: anchor, pallet, escape wheel, pendulum (regulating device).
blocks.caption: Woh aala jis ne pendulum clock ko amali banaya (Do You Know; kitab ki figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Escape wheel ko ghari ka spring ya wazan ghumata hai. Pendulum har jhool par anchor ko idhar udhar jhulata hai, aur anchor ka ek pallet wheel ka ek daant chhorta hai jabke doosra agla daant rok leta hai. Is tarah wheel har jhool par sirf ek daant aage barhta hai, aur pendulum ka barabar waqt (period) ghari ki raftar ko qaboo (regulate) karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Jaanchein ke v^2 = v_i^2 + 2 a S dimensionally durust hai ya nahi, aur dimensions se dikhayein ke saada pendulum ka period T, l aur g par T = constant x sqrt(l/g) ki tarah munhasir hai (numerical problem 1.8).
blocks.explanation: [v^2] = [LT^-1]^2 = [L^2 T^-2]; [v_i^2] wahi hai, aur [a S] = [LT^-2][L] = [L^2 T^-2], to har term ki dimensions [L^2 T^-2] hain aur equation homogeneous hai. Pendulum ke liye farz karein T = (constant) l^a g^b: [T] = [L]^a [LT^-2]^b = [L^(a+b) T^-2b], to a + b = 0 aur -2b = 1, jis se b = -1/2 aur a = 1/2; is liye T = constant x l^(1/2) g^(-1/2) = constant x sqrt(l/g). Constant (2 pi) dimensions se nahi mil sakta.

items: Dimensions: [L], [M], [T], [A], [theta]; [v] = [LT^-1], [a] = [LT^-2], [F] = [MLT^-2]. Homogeneity: durust equation ke dono taraf ek jaisi dimensions (S = 1/2 a t^2 se [L] = [L]); adadi factors ki dimensions nahi.
Derivation: F = (constant) m^a v^b r^c, powers milane se a = 1, b = 2, c = -1, to F = m v^2 / r (constant tajurbe se 1). Had: constants ki ya equation kahan ghalat hai is ki jaanch nahi.
